details.description:
ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Health Nutrition Since 1968, Royal Canin has been following the belief that nutrition plays a key role in supporting the health and wellbeing of cats and dogs. This is why we have designed ROYAL CANIN® veterinary diets around proven nutritional science in partnership with pet professionals and experts, delivering nutrition for pets with specific health needs.

ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac dry dog food is a dry kibble diet specially tailored to nutritionally support adult dogs with cardiac insufficiency. 

ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac diet for dogs is suitable for:
•	Dogs with cardiovascular disease.
•	Dogs with congestive heart failure.
•	Dogs with hypertension.

Key benefits:
•	Cardiac support
o	ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac is formulated with specific nutrients that help to support your dog’s heart function. 
•	EPA + DHA
o	ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac contains EPA and DHA, essential Omega-3 fatty acids that help to further support cardiac function. 
•	Low sodium
o	This formula contains a restricted sodium content to help reduce the workload of your dog’s heart. 

Royal Canin are proud to partner with leading veterinary scientists to produce a cardiac diet for dogs with heart disease . As part of the ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Range, it is important that this product is only fed to your pet when recommended by a veterinary professional. Transitioning your pet from one diet to another should be a smooth and gradual process over a 7-10-day period. Please ensure you follow the correct rationing amount.

To cater to each dog's individual appetite and preferences, ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac is also available as wet food. If you feed your dog a mixture of wet and dry food, be sure to reference the on-pack feeding guides to ensure a healthy daily food intake for your dog. 

Please note: Royal Canin Cardiac is not suitable for growth, pregnancy, lactation, obesity or dogs with IRIS stage 3 or stage for chronic kidney disease.

original_product.product_description_long_audience_pet_ow: ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac is a dry kibble diet specially tailored to nutritionally support adult dogs with cardiac insufficiency. ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac is formulated with specific nutrients – including taurine and L-Carnitine – that help to support heart function.  ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac contains EPA and DHA, essential Omega-3 fatty acids that help to further support cardiac function. ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac is formulated with a restricted sodium content to help reduce the workload of your dog’s heart. To cater to each dog’s individual appetite and taste preferences, ROYAL CANIN® Cardiac is also available as wet food with a loaf-like texture. If you feed your dog a mixture of wet and dry food, be sure to reference the on-pack feeding guides to ensure a healthy daily food intake for your dog.  Each of our unique veterinary support formulas contains specific nutrients to provide your dog with a complete and balanced diet.
